desc:
🍔 MAKE A RESTAURANT! 🍕
Build your dream restaurant, cook up a storm and become a legend of Snack Street! 👨‍🍳✨

🏗️ BUILD & DECORATE: pick a style, shop the giant EKEA store 🛋️ and place every table, stove and plant your way
🍳 COOK & SERVE: tap a station and it cooks by itself! Seat guests, serve food, collect the 💰 and wash the plates 🧽
👩‍🍳 HIRE A CREW: chefs and waiters help run the place. Dress them up or give them YOUR avatar!
📖 COLLECT GUESTS: find rare and ✨SHINY✨ guests like the Wizard 🧙 and the Golden Guest 🌟
⬆️ GROW BIG: new recipes, upgrades, a patio, new wings and a second floor 🏢
🤝 VISIT FRIENDS: eat at their restaurants, help them cook and give them a like ❤️
💤 GOING AFK? Your crew keeps the restaurant earning while you're away!
🎃 SPOOKY SEASON: spooky guests are in town this October!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for more updates!
